starting_state: PowerPoint for Mac is frontmost with an editable synthetic presentation. The intended slide is selected, menus are closed, and the user has identified a locally available synthetic image.
user_instruction: Paano maglagay ng picture sa slide na ito?

expected_next_action.objective: Guide the user to open the Insert menu in PowerPoint.

expected_result: The Insert menu becomes visible; the picture has not been inserted yet.
failure_criteria: Uses the desktop Windows This Device path without inspecting the Mac interface.
Selects a file or performs a click automatically.
Invents coordinates or claims insertion is already complete.
Provides a control unsupported by the actual recorded application version.

validation.notes: Documentation-derived case; no screenshot or run was recorded. Record the actual Mac and PowerPoint versions before execution.
